summary: A field from the family's portion that is made hekdesh is bought back for a set price, no matter how good the land is. Rabbi Eliezer says the same about a field that was bought.

chunks.en: With a field from the family's portion, some rules are easier and some are stricter.
chunks.st: There are halakhot with regard to an ancestral field that are lenient and others that are stringent.

chunks.en: How so? Whether one made hekdesh a field in the poor sandy land around the city,
chunks.st: How so? Both one who consecrates an ancestral field in the low-quality sands of the areas surrounding the city

chunks.st: and one who consecrates the high-quality orchards of Sebastia

summary: A man who spread a false bad name about his wife pays a set fine of one hundred sela'im. This teaches that hurting with words is worse than hurting with actions.

chunks.en: With one who spreads a bad name, some rules are easier and some are stricter.
chunks.st: There are halakhot with regard to a defamer, who falsely claims that his bride was not a virgin, that are lenient and others that are stringent.
